LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingDisplayMode: How much of the maths to show
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_DisplayModePlainDesc: Signal bars and a plain-English reason. Radio just works.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_DisplayModeOperatorDesc: Adds the band, the signal-to-noise ratio, the margin and which direction limits the link.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_DisplayModeEngineerDesc: The whole link-budget sheet, every gain and loss, in both directions.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingMetresPerCellDesc: What one map cell measures. Decide before you start a colony: changing it later changes every distance and cable loss, so links that worked may stop. The game never defines it; 1 m matches the furniture, about 26 m matches walking speed.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingInTouchThought: "In touch with home" mood for colonists whose radio reaches a base station
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingInTouchThoughtDesc: A small mood bonus for a free colonist wearing a hand-held with a working link to a base station. Turn it off to keep the radios as a pure readout.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_StationNoPower: The base station has no power, so there is nothing to reach.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_NoStation: No base station on this map, so there is nothing to reach.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_StationNoRadios: No hand-held radios worn on this map.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SitingQuiet: Quiet: no colony noise reaches here
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_PortCableNoAntenna: Coax connected, but no antenna on it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_PortCableNoStation: Coax connected, but no base station on it.
